dialogues.speaker: Observe the censer
dialogues.text: (Everlasting Incense... The lengths we went to to get our hands on that. The powders made from Glaze Lilies still remain at the bottom.)

dialogues.speaker: Observe the censer
dialogues.text: (Two million, nine-hundred-and-ninety thousand Mora's worth of incense, going up in smoke... Ugh...)
